rule: This is handled as two identical steps: choose a Career Event, gain whatever benefits it provides, and then repeat the process, giving the character two definitive Career Events. Each Career Event increases one attribute and one department by one point each, and gives the character one additional focus.
noviceNote: Younger characters may assume that one or both of their Career Events occurred during their training—such as cadets gaining field experience aboard a ship during their third or fourth year.
note: Events in the book's table order (p.128). attribute.id / discipline.id of null means the book lets the player choose any one. focus.examples holds the book's named focus suggestions; it is empty where the book only describes what the focus should reflect. The book's optional event traits are not used. Ids are kept from the earlier Captain's Log data (art paths are built from them).

events.name: Betrayed Ideals for a Superior
events.description: The character was placed in a situation where they had to choose between a trusted superior and their own ideals, and they chose to follow the superior.

events.name: Breakthrough or Invention
events.description: The character made an important technological discovery, devised a new way of using a particular technology, or invented some new technology that will be invaluable in the future.

events.name: Called Out a Superior
events.description: The character was placed in a situation where they had to choose between a trusted superior and their own ideals, and they chose to follow their ideals.

focus.text: Uniform Code of Justice, History, Starfleet Protocol.

events.name: Conflict with a Hostile Culture
events.description: The character was involved in a battle with a hostile force.

focus.text: Hand Phasers, Hand-to-Hand Combat, Tactical Systems.

events.name: Dealt with a Plague
events.description: The character’s ship was assigned to provide aid to a world dealing with an epidemic.

events.name: Death of a Friend
events.description: One of the character’s friends was killed in action.

focus.text: Counseling, but it may also represent a skill or pursuit the character takes up in their fallen friend’s memory.

events.name: Discovered an Artifact
events.description: The character discovered a device or fragment of technology from a now-extinct civilization.

events.name: Encountered a Truly Alien Being
events.description: The character encountered a life-form which is truly alien, something barely within the comprehension of humanoid life. It might have been some godlike entity, or a creature that swims through space, but whatever it was, it was not life as we know it.

events.name: First Contact
events.description: The character was involved in one of the most important of Starfleet’s missions: first contact with another culture.

events.name: Lauded by Another Culture
events.description: The character was involved in a mission that earned the official praise of a non-Federation culture; they are now considered to be a friend to those people.

focus.text: A focus of X Culture, replacing the X with the name of that culture or any that represent skills or techniques specific to that culture.

events.name: Learned Unique Language
events.description: The character encounters a species with an unusual form of communication and learns to communicate with them.

events.name: Mentored
events.description: A highly-respected officer took notice of the character’s career. For a time, the character served as the officer’s pilot and aide, gaining the benefit of the officer’s experiences and lessons.

focus.text: Composure or Etiquette, any focus reflecting the officer’s specialties.

events.name: Negotiated a Treaty
events.description: The character was part of a delegation that helped negotiate a treaty, agreement, or alliance with a culture outside the Federation.

events.name: New Battle Strategy
events.description: In combat with a hostile force, the character devised a new strategy or tactic.

events.name: Required to Take Command
events.description: During a mission, a crisis left the mission’s leader unable to lead. This required the character to take command, something they may not have been prepared for.

events.name: Serious Injury
events.description: The character was seriously hurt and needed to spend a considerable amount of time recovering.

focus.text: The focus should reflect the circumstances of the character’s injury, something that helped them through recovery, or something they took up after recovering.

events.name: Ship Destroyed
events.description: The ship the character was serving on was destroyed during a mission, and the character was one of the few who survived.

focus.text: Extra Vehicular Operations, Small Craft, Survival.

events.name: Solved an Engineering Crisis
events.description: The character was instrumental in ending a crisis caused by malfunctioning technology and saved many lives in the process.

focus.text: Electro-Plasma Power Systems, Fusion Reactors, Warp Engines.

events.name: Special Commendation
events.description: During a crisis, the character saved the lives of several colleagues, helping them to safety. This earned the character a special commendation.

events.name: Transporter Accident
events.description: The character suffered some manner of strange accident while using a transporter.

focus.text: Transporters & Replicators, Small Craft, Quantum Mechanics.
